description_html: Greg answers questions from callers about whether abortion is ever necessary to save the life of the mother, how to respond to someone who thinks Genesis 6:5–7 indicates that our Creator makes mistakes, and who the “gods” are that God presides over according to Psalm 82.

title: Does Genesis 6:5–7 Indicate That Even Our Creator Makes Mistakes?
